summary: Professional Diversity Network filed an 8-K reporting that wholly owned PDN Intelligence entered an equipment lease, tri-party compute collaboration and secured loan with Goodwill Labs and HashForest on October 5, 2026. The arrangements fund roughly $1.177 million for two NVIDIA B300 eight-GPU systems: PDN buys one system from AMAX for $588,581.99 and lends Goodwill $588,849.23 for a second. Lease runs 60 months at about $117,716 annual rent, with early termination after year two. This is an ordinary commercial equipment and financing contract, not a special situation.
